text_block_list.text:
Today's training concluded without 
incident, and all that was left was to 
head home, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Just like a beast. Starving and 
thirsty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You want it, don't you? Prey upon which to 
unleash... that overwhelming heat.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... So you went out of your way to 
offer yourself to a wolf? What a truly 
merciful lady you are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, do I look like a lady to you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Anyone who calls out to a wolf 
and then laughs when it turns around is—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Now I'm in the mood. I'll run 
alongside you. Your Trainer doesn't mind, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Would that be alright with you? ...Until 
the turf is dyed in the black of night.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to the results of the 
hunt.
Let's stop here. You'll overwork yourself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Listen to Villager Number One talk... I'll 
tear your prized hunter to shreds right in 
front of your eyes.

That day, the fierce side-by-side run 
between wolf and hunter continued until 
night fell.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...*Sigh*, that completely killed the 
mood. Are you really gonna lecture me with 
logic right now?"

Though she seemed dissatisfied, Mejiro 
Ramonu wrapped up training as instructed.
